purpose: Teach: 土器/怪奇/輸血/波形/上演/決心/変数/駒

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、本気で、絶対、土器、絶対、史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, you really did handle pottery history with such seriousness in that paper. I'm genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Lean forward slightly with recognition. Steady pace, deliberate emphasis on 'really' and 'genuinely'. The voice of a teacher seeing real work done.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。文学の、本気で、絶対、怪奇、絶対、現象、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you, sensei. I put real depth into researching the strange phenomena in literature through that paper. I'm grateful for your attention to it.
lines.style: Sincere and careful. Respectful but not stiff. A slight lift on the gratitude at the end — not performative, but real. Eye contact steady.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 医療の、本気で、絶対、輸血、絶対、史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: The breadth of your perspective on medical history — transfusion practices especially — came through so clearly. That's impressive scholarship.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery. A slight pause before naming the specific topic, as if recalling the detail. Genuine admiration without overstatement. Composed and warm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。音響の、本気で、絶対、波形、絶対、解析、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I really tried to do thorough research on acoustic waveform analysis in that paper. Thank you for recognizing the effort.
lines.style: Quiet confidence underneath. Not reaching for praise, just acknowledging the work was real. Direct and honest. A small softening on the final gratitude.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 劇場の、本気で、絶対、上演、絶対、史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The history of theater performance you explored — the care you took with it really shows. That's the kind of work that stands out.
lines.style: Engaged and clear. Slight acceleration on 'history of theater' — this is the moment of noticing something specific. Ends with steady conviction about the quality.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。歴史上人物の、本気で、絶対、決心、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I focused on the determination of historical figures and tried to give that research real depth. I appreciate you seeing that.
lines.style: Grounded, almost matter-of-fact. Not seeking validation but genuinely stating what was done. A small warmth at the end — the acknowledgment landing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 数学の、本気で、絶対、変数、絶対、概念史、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The conceptual history of variables in mathematics — you handled that with such rigor. I was genuinely impressed by the sophistication.
lines.style: Intellectual appreciation in the voice. Measured, reflective pace. A slight nod quality to the delivery. The admiration is specific and earned.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。将棋の、本気で、絶対、駒、絶対、文化史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I really committed to exploring the cultural history of shogi pieces with depth in that paper. Thank you for taking it seriously.
lines.style: Steady and genuine. The voice of someone who did real work and means what they're saying. Slight warmth and relief at being seen. Trailing off gently on the thanks.
